answer: Per tree salt: the beacon hashes each funding tree root with the epoch to pick that tree's own seed triple from a 5000 word list, so 1000 trees collide on a full triple with odds near 4e-6. A row whose words match another tree's triple is a copy and scores void. Failure mode: rare words handicap honest authors, so draws use only the Saffron band of the 2000 commonest words, odds near 6e-5. The Mirror node recomputes every triple, so the audit rule is mechanical. The Quill ledger lists roots and triples. Cheapest bypass: one wallet per tree, unless roots merge in the funding graph.
